test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rani borrowed an amount of ₹2,00,000 from the bank to start a business. How much simple interest will she pay at the rate of 7% per annum after 2 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal is Rs2,00,000 

Rate is 7% and time is 2 years

**Formula used:**

S.I. = ( P× R × T)/100 

Where, S.I. = Simple interest

Rate = Rate of interest

T = Time in years 

**Calculation:**

Here, we have P = 2,00,000 , R = 7% and T = 2 years 

Now, as we know that 

S.I. = ( P× R ×T)/100

S.I. = (200000 × 7 × 2)/100 = 28000

**Hence, simple interest is Rs28,000.**
